# GET /api/v1/packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}

Gets all versions of a specific package

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-204`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |

| name | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |
